1170-1329-1482-8201.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Jeweled Lotus from your graveyard.
Cast Jeweled Lotus by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Jeweled Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

602-4067-4691.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
602-4067-4691.description:
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card.
Feast of Sanity triggers, dealing 1 damage to you and causing you to gain 1 life.
Vilis triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, tapping or untapping an applicable permanent
Repeat

2790-4836-5361.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is equal to or greater than 55 minus 4 for each opponent you have.
Auton Soldier is a copy of Angel of Destiny and does not have summoning sickness.
2790-4836-5361.notablePrerequisites: Opponents cannot block creatures you control.
2790-4836-5361.description:
Declare Auton Soldier as an attacker. Its myriad ability triggers, creating a tapped and attacking copy of Auton Soldier, which is a copy of Angel of Destiny, attacking each other opponent.
Deal combat damage with Auton Soldier, causing each Auton Soldier to trigger, causing you to gain 4 life for each Auton Soldier and causing each opponent to gain 4 life.
Move to your end step. The Auton Soldier tokens won't be exiled due to The Master.
At the beginning of your end step, each Auton Soldier triggers, causing each opponent they dealt combat damage to to lose the game.

1809-5531-5694-6763-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
1809-5531-5694-6763-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Returned Pastcaller and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Returned Pastcaller and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
Resolve the Returned Pastcaller trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
Repeat.
1809-5531-5694-6763-8110.notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Returned Pastcaller and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

1170-4030-4779-5131--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-4030-4779-5131--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Starnheim Courser.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing the artifact, giving Krark-Clan Grunt +1/+0 and first strike until end of turn
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more lore counters on it

2921-7084-7885.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Down in the Valley triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-2719-4865.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-2719-4865.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Vesuvan Shapeshifter and Sakashima of a Thousand Faces each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Vesuvan Shapeshifter trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Sakashima of a Thousand Faces trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-2719-4865.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

uses.n: Kirol, History Buff // Pack a Punch

1402-4453-7547--85.description:
Activate Diamond Lion by tapping it, discarding your hand, and sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}{R} or {W}{W}{W}.
Cast a copy of Pack a Punch from exile by paying {1}{W}{R}, targeting Tethmos High Priest, unpreparing Kirol.
When you cast that spell, Tethmos High Priest triggers, returning Diamond Lion from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Diamond Lion leaves your graveyard, Kirol triggers, becoming prepared.
Pack a Punch resolves, causing you to mill a card, put two +1/+1 counters onto Tethmos High Priest, and give it trample until end of turn.
Repeat.

3532-3761-5078-7356.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-3761-5078-7356.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Longshot triggers, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Arcbound Crusher triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Crusher.
Repeat.

4947-5078-6766-7297.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Diving Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Sai triggers, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Activate the Thopter token by tapping it, adding {U} that can only be spent to cast spells from anywhere except your hand.
Repeat.

2653-2893-4826-5455.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
When the basic land enters, Nissa and Bristly Bill trigger.
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Bristly Bill trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1183-4853-6700.description:
Activate Sarevok's Tome by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Pentavus's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Pentavite creature token.
Activate Pentavus's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing the Pentavite.
When the Pentavite dies, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Sarevok's Tome.
Resolve the Pentavus ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2091-5913-6785.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least ten tapped lands.
2091-5913-6785.description:
Cast Mana Geyser by paying {3}{R}{R}, adding {R} for each tapped land your opponents control.
Cast Devastating Onslaught by paying {4}{R}, creating two token copies of Pinnacle Monk with haste.
When the Pinnacle Monk tokens enter, they trigger, returning Mana Geyser and Devastating Onslaught from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

339-677-4050-4927.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1987-2556-4125-4276.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
1987-2556-4125-4276.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mnemonic Wall and Shipwreck Dowser.
When Mnemonic Wall and Shipwreck Dowser enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-2556-4125-4276.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

372-1309-3378.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Illusionist's Stratagem exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-1309-3378.description:
Cast Illusionist's Stratagem by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Salvager of Secrets and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Salvager of Secrets trigger.
Resolve the Salvager of Secrets trigger, returning Illusionist's Stratagem from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Illusionist's Stratagem.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Salvager of Secrets and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

2018-2292-2946-4871.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2018-2292-2946-4871.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Luminous Broodmoth and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Luminous Broodmoth trigger, returning Cult Conscript from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer abilities from steps 1 and 5, causing you to scry 1 twice.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

3652-4875-5852.notablePrerequisites: Conspiracy on the battlefield with "Sliver" chosen
3652-4875-5852.description:
Cast Ornithopter by paying {0}, and choosing to pay its replicate cost an arbitrarily large number of times by paying {0}.
Ornithopter triggers, creating a copy of it for each time its replicate cost was paid.
Resolve all Ornithopter spells, causing the nontoken Ornithopter to enter the battlefield, and creating a token copy of it for each time its replicate cost was paid.

373-877-997-4484.notablePrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich died this turn.
"Zombie" chosen with Morophon.
373-877-997-4484.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Ebondeath, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

1636-4312-4746.notablePrerequisites:
Pallid Mycoderm has at least three spore counters on it.
Vorel of the Hull Clade does not have summoning sickness.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {G}{U}.
1636-4312-4746.description:
Activate all mana-producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {G}{U}.
Activate Vorel of the Hull Clade by paying {G}{U} and tapping it, doubling the number of counters on Pallid Mycoderm.
Activate Pallid Mycoderm's first ability by removing three spore counters from it, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
When the Saproling enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
If creatures you control can tap to produce at least {1}{G}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana and you may target any creature using Vorel of the Hull Clade.
This combo also nets infinite spore counters on Pallid Mycoderm if it has four or more spore counters to start the combo, and you may also optionally sacrifice the Saproling tokens to Pallid Mycoderm's ability.

uses.n: Etali, Primal Conqueror // Etali, Primal Sickness

2178-4147-4294-5147.manaNeeded: {5}{R}{R} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
2178-4147-4294-5147.notablePrerequisites:
It is your precombat main phase.
Hua Tuo does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Hua Tuo.
2178-4147-4294-5147.description:
Cast Etali from your hand or from the command zone by paying {5}{R}{R} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Etali enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Etali.
If Etali is your commander, choose not to return it to the command zone from your graveyard.
When Etali dies, Hua Tuo triggers, untapping Hua Tuo.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Hua Tuo by tapping it, putting Etali on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Etali trigger from step 2, causing you to exile cards from each player's library until you exile a nonland card, with you exiling Etali from your library, and cast Etali and any other nonland cards exiled this way without paying their mana costs.
Repeat from step 2.

1144-1284-2178-4180.notablePrerequisites: Viridian Longbow and Thornbite Staff attached to the same creature you control without summoning sickness.
1144-1284-2178-4180.description:
Whenever a land enters the battlefield, it enters as a 1/1 creature due to Yavimaya and Living Lands.
Activate the creature with Viridian Longbow and Thornbite Staff attached by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to the land.
The land dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
The creature triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat as desired for each land an opponent controls, and whenever a land enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

2757-3430-4499.description:
Activate a basic land by tapping it, adding {3}.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Nyxbloom Ancient.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Nyxbloom Ancient, untapping a basic land.
Repeat.

3176-4398.description:
Whenever a player casts an instant or sorcery spell, Eye of the Storm triggers, exiling that spell.
Because Archon of Emeria prevents players from casting more than one spell each turn, players cannot cast the spell permitted by Eye of the Storm, or any other spell that turn.

262-5153.notablePrerequisites:
Elemental Mastery attached to Sunstrike Legionnaire.
Sunstrike Legionnaire does not have summoning sickness.
262-5153.description:
Activate Sunstrike Legionnaire by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Elemental creature token with haste.
When the Elemental enters the battlefield, Sunstrike Legionnaire triggers, untapping it.
Repeat.

444-618-667-2836-3473-4067-4562.notablePrerequisites:
One additional card in hand.
Your life total is greater than your starting life total.
444-618-667-2836-3473-4067-4562.description:
Tap Kiki-Jiki to activate it, creating token copy of Drogskol Reaver.
Discard a card to activate Mind Over Matter, untapping Kiki-Jiki.
Pay {3}{W}{W}{W} to cast Transcendence.
Transcendence's second ability triggers.
In response, tap Kiki-Jiki to activate it, creating a token copy of Exquisite Archangel.
Resolve Transcendence's ability modified by the token Exquisite Archangel's replacement effect, exiling the token and reducing your life total to your starting life total.
Transcendence's second and third abilities each trigger.
Resolve its third ability, gaining life equal to twice the amount you lost.
The token and nontoken Drogskol Reavers each trigger, causing you to draw two cards.
Discard a card to activate Mind Over Matter, untapping Kiki-Jiki.
Tap Kiki-Jiki to activate it, creating a token copy of Exquisite Archangel.
Repeat from step 6 until there is one card remaining in your library.
Discard a card to activate Mind Over Matter, untapping a land you control.
Tap that land to add one mana.
Repeat the previous two steps three more times, until you have a total of {2}{W}{U} available.
Pay {W} to cast Scout's Warning, letting you cast your next creature spell as though it had flash and drawing a card.
Pay {2}{U} to cast Laboratory Maniac.
Repeat steps 6 through 9 one more time, modifying a Drogskol Reaver ability with Laboratory Maniac's replacement effect.

1358-3469-5261.easyPrerequisites:
Energy Arc is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Isochron Scepter doesn't have summoning sickness.
1358-3469-5261.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
1358-3469-5261.description:
Animate Isochron Scepter using Sydri.
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Energy Arc without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Energy Arc, untapping all creatures you control
Repeat from step 2.
